test_yard.name: Yard workshop
test_yard.description: Crates, a toolbox and a medical bag behind the low wall in the middle of the yard.

test_yard.name: Dark storeroom
test_yard.description: The windowless room in the north-west: a weapon box, a filing cabinet and a medicine cabinet. Bring a light.

test_yard.name: Field clinic
test_yard.description: A lab cabinet and a medical crate against the north wall.

test_yard.name: Signal hut
test_yard.description: A PC, a server rack and a safe on the east wall.

test_yard.name: Corner shop
test_yard.description: A fridge and a store shelf in the south-east corner.

test_yard.name: West squat
test_yard.description: A kitchen cabinet and a chest of drawers someone was living out of, by the west wall.

test_yard.name: Stash under the floorboards
test_yard.description: Loose boards behind the hedge, and a smuggler's stash under them.

test_yard.name: Wrecked courier van
test_yard.description: A courier van that never made its delivery, nose-down in the middle of the yard. Its cargo is still in the back.

test_yard.name: Shuttered bunker
test_yard.description: A concrete bunker on the north wall, shut by a steel shutter. The lever that raises it is on the far west wall.

factory.name: Main hall
factory.description: Presses, lathes and a conveyor under the crane, with a catwalk along the north wall.

factory.name: Overseer's office
factory.description: Up the stairs above the hall floor: a safe, the overseer's files and his PC.

factory.name: Boiler house
factory.description: Dark, hot and loud. The boiler house power switch and the cellar hatch are here.

factory.name: Offices
factory.description: Records, the server room and the archive, off one corridor.

factory.name: Locker rooms
factory.description: Lockers, a break room and the showers.

factory.name: Med bay
factory.description: Beds, medicine cabinets and the chem storage room.

factory.name: Lab
factory.description: Behind the med bay's locked metal door: lab cabinets and whatever the chemists left.

factory.name: Warehouse
factory.description: Shelving, pallets and crates by the loading dock.

factory.name: Armory cage
factory.description: The guards' weapon boxes behind a wire cage in the warehouse. Everyone knows it's there.

factory.name: Foreman's floor stash
factory.description: A loose panel in the break room floor, where the foreman kept what he skimmed.

factory.name: Generator bunker
factory.description: A sealed bunker in the boiler yard. Its blast door runs on the factory's power.

factory.name: Crashed supply truck
factory.description: A supply truck that ran into the med bay wall. The driver's long gone; the cargo isn't.

customs_yard.name: Dorms
customs_yard.description: Two blocks of worker dorms, most doors kicked in.

customs_yard.name: Dorm room 114
customs_yard.description: The one door in the dorms nobody kicked in.

customs_yard.name: Marked room
customs_yard.description: A red-marked door in the dorms. Rumours say it's full of money.

customs_yard.name: Construction site
customs_yard.description: Half-built concrete frames, scaffolding and site huts.

customs_yard.name: Fuel depot
customs_yard.description: Tanks, a pump house and the gas station shop.

customs_yard.name: Customs office
customs_yard.description: Seized-goods files and the officers' PCs.

customs_yard.name: Trailer park
customs_yard.description: Trailers by the fence, next to the trailer park extract.

customs_yard.name: Smuggler's crawlspace
customs_yard.description: A hatch under a trailer's floor, where the smugglers stashed their cut.

customs_yard.name: Overturned armored van
customs_yard.description: A cash van on its roof by the overpass. Its strongbox is dented but shut.

customs_yard.name: Railway signal bunker
customs_yard.description: A buried signal bunker by the tracks; the points lever raises its hatch.

woodland.name: Sawmill
woodland.description: Log piles, saw sheds and the mill office.

woodland.name: Hunter's lodge
woodland.description: A locked lodge on the ridge, rifles still on the rack.

woodland.name: Scav camp
woodland.description: Tents, a fire pit and stolen crates in the clearing.

woodland.name: Radio tower
woodland.description: A relay tower and its equipment hut on the hill.

woodland.name: Abandoned village
woodland.description: A handful of wooden houses the forest is taking back.

woodland.name: Old army checkpoint
woodland.description: Sandbags, a barrier and an empty guard post on the logging road.

woodland.name: Cache under the old oak
woodland.description: Someone buried a crate between the roots of the biggest tree in the forest.

woodland.name: Downed helicopter
woodland.description: A transport helicopter in the treeline, rotor torn off.

woodland.name: Forester's root cellar
woodland.description: A locked cellar door in the hillside behind the forester's house.

shoreline.name: Resort west wing
shoreline.description: Guest rooms on the locked west side of the health resort.

shoreline.name: Resort east wing
shoreline.description: The east wing's treatment rooms and staff quarters.

shoreline.name: Resort admin office
shoreline.description: The director's office at the top of the resort, with the safe.

shoreline.name: Pier
shoreline.description: Boat sheds and fuel drums at the end of the pier.

shoreline.name: Weather station
shoreline.description: Instruments and radios on the headland.

shoreline.name: Power station
shoreline.description: Transformers and the switch that brings the resort's power back.

shoreline.name: Beached yacht
shoreline.description: A rich man's yacht thrown up on the rocks, cabin still dry.

shoreline.name: Pool-house crawlspace
shoreline.description: A floor hatch in the empty pool house.

shoreline.name: Cliffside bunker
shoreline.description: A coastal defence bunker in the cliff, its door on the resort's power.

labs.name: Main lobby
labs.description: The reception hall at the bottom of the elevator.

labs.name: Cafeteria
labs.description: Vending machines and a kitchen nobody cleaned.

labs.name: Research wing
labs.description: The red-card labs where the real work was done.

labs.name: Server hall
labs.description: Racks of servers behind doors that only open with the power on.

labs.name: Manager's office
labs.description: The black-card office overlooking the labs.

labs.name: Security armory
labs.description: The security team's armory, violet card only.

labs.name: Specimen vault
labs.description: A cold room behind the manager's office that isn't on any floor plan.

labs.name: Collapsed service tunnel
labs.description: A crashed maintenance cart where the tunnel roof came down.

labs.name: Under-floor cable stash
labs.description: A lifted floor tile in the server hall, and a technician's private stash under it.
